new_value: Implemented in 3624bf9 as hire-core/src/hint.rs. Encoding: source=<attestor>&identity_assurance=<iaa>&presence=<level>&age=<seconds>, with Display and FromStr and a round-trip test carrying an example tag for every source that can prove today plus the fido2 case that cannot yet. No new vocabulary: source and identity_assurance are hire claim-block field names, presence takes the same values as hire_require_presence, age is seconds like hire_max_age. Unknown and repeated keys are parse errors, matching the closed hire_ namespace rule -- a caller gating on the tag must never be told yes by a daemon carrying a field the caller could not see. Decided on the persona-5s4b.129 question: the tag names the SOURCE, because Claim::source() is what the daemon actually has; when auth_methods becomes distinct from sources, adding it is a new key rather than a change of meaning here.
